meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 导入已有小说,直接续写
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你已有写好的小说,想用标准流程续写或整理。
copy.tagline_en: Import existing novels and continue writing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an existing novel and want to continue or organize it in a structured workflow.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，当你提供一本已写好的小说（半成品或完本），Claude会把它拆解成可续写的标准项目结构，包含设定、大纲、正文、追踪等，之后你就能继续写新章节。
howto.when: 当你说“导入小说”“反向解析”等关键词，或使用/story-import命令时触发。

say.note: 开始拆解这本书，生成写作工程。

say.text: 反向解析这本小说，按短篇处理
say.note: 会走短篇拆解流程，产出标准结构。

say.text: 把我的书导进来，做成能续写的工程
say.note: 生成目录后可接着写第N+1章。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you provide an already-written novel (partial or complete), Claude reverse-parses it into a standard writable project structure with settings, outline, chapters, and tracking, so you can continue writing new chapters later.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention phrases like 'import a novel' or 'reverse-parse', or when you use the /story-import command.

say_en.text: Import my novel: file is D:/novel.txt
say_en.note: Starts analyzing and building the project.

say_en.text: Reverse-analyze this novel, treat it as a short story.
Bring my book in and set it up for further writing.
say_en.note: Creates a project to continue from chapter N+1.
